evals.prompt: upgrade my sale_custom + sale_discount cluster from Odoo 16 to 17 and make them installable and working on 17
evals.expected_output: Named 2-module cluster, explicit 16->17 major bump, installable+working goal.

evals.prompt: migrate our custom modules up to v18 - I think core now absorbs a couple of them, handle the deletions too
evals.expected_output: Cluster major upgrade to v18 incl. core-absorption deletions - core P2 handling.

evals.prompt: nâng cấp cluster module custom của chúng tôi lên Odoo 17, làm cho chạy được
evals.expected_output: Vietnamese cluster major upgrade to Odoo 17; language-agnostic trigger.

evals.prompt: bring these 5 addons up to the next major series and land it as one reviewed PR
evals.expected_output: 5-addon cluster, next major, one reviewed PR - matches the ONE-PR dep-order pipeline.

evals.prompt: this module is stuck on 16 - make it installable and working on Odoo 18
evals.expected_output: Single module (cluster of one), 16->18 major bump, installable+working.

evals.prompt: forward-port just this one commit from 16.0 to 17.0
evals.expected_output: Transport ONE commit across majors -> odoo-forward-port, not a whole-cluster upgrade.

evals.prompt: rebase my 17.0-feature branch onto the updated origin/17.0
evals.expected_output: Rebase onto updated origin/17.0 = SAME series, no major bump -> odoo-git-rebase.

evals.prompt: give me a risk and deprecation plan for upgrading to v18 - don't touch the code yet, I just need scope
evals.expected_output: Risk/deprecation PLAN only, no code touched -> /odoo-plan-upgrade (upgrade EXECUTES).

evals.prompt: scan my modules for deprecated API usage before we think about upgrading
what changed in the account module API between v16 and v17?
evals.expected_output: API delta between two versions only -> odoo-version-diff.

evals.prompt: write a fresh Odoo 18 module for gift-card management from scratch
evals.expected_output: Fresh module from scratch - nothing to carry across a major -> odoo-coding.

evals.prompt: our loyalty module needs to run on v17 AND it has real production customer data to preserve - handle the upgrade
evals.expected_output: Code-level upgrade fires, but real production data to preserve -> data-bearing part routes to odoo-data-migration (never inline).

evals.prompt: we already ran /odoo-plan-upgrade and have the report at .odoo-ai/upgrade/plan.md - now actually execute the upgrade to v18 using it
evals.expected_output: Executes the v18 upgrade, consuming an existing /odoo-plan-upgrade report as optional --plan input.

evals.prompt: chỉ cần audit các symbol deprecated thôi, chưa cần nâng cấp gì cả
evals.expected_output: Vietnamese deprecated-symbol audit only, no upgrade -> odoo-deprecation-audit.

evals.prompt: we renamed partner_ref to customer_ref and need to backfill the existing rows in the database - write the migration
evals.expected_output: Field rename + row backfill = real DATA transform, not a code-level module upgrade -> odoo-data-migration.

evals.prompt: take our whole 15.0 addons repo and get it running on 17.0 - installable, tests passing, one PR
evals.expected_output: Whole-repo cluster major upgrade 15.0->17.0, installable + tests green + one PR - full-delegation scope.

notes: 16 upgrade-decision cases. Eval method: a subagent applies SKILL.md (esp. the Out-of-Scope discriminator table) to each prompt and returns {fires, decision, note}, graded vs expected. Covers trigger-vs-defer across all six neighbors (forward-port = one commit; git-rebase = same series; /odoo-plan-upgrade = plan-only; deprecation-audit / version-diff = detection-only; odoo-coding = fresh code; odoo-data-migration = real data transform) plus two special notes: data-carveout (code upgrade fires but data-bearing work routes to odoo-data-migration, never inline) and takes-plan-input (consumes a prior /odoo-plan-upgrade report). Baseline (pre-optimize snapshot) scored 16/16; shipped as a decision-regression guard (the skill had none). No SKILL.md change: the discriminator table was already complete and the description is at 997/1024, so no edit was warranted. The eval does NOT execute a real upgrade or grade adapted code.
